name: Sensory Calm

intent_defaults.description: A wearer-led starting point for reducing unwanted tactile features and making fabric, seam, label, closure and fit preferences explicit.
intent_defaults.silhouette: User-defined; avoid assumptions about the cause of sensory preferences.

accessibility_defaults: All fit, closure, coverage and material choices remain user-editable.
circularity_defaults: Offer repair, alteration and modular-replacement options where compatible with the wearer intent.
caveats: Sensory comfort is individual and cannot be inferred from a fabric name or simulated image.
Evaluate the actual garment with the intended wearer; do not infer a diagnosis or medical need.
